name: omp-advisor-consensus
description: Advisor-driven adversarial loop with an independent reviewer gate, escalating only when a goal is blocked on operator-only physical input

omp.description: Unanswered advisor findings re-prompt the main session; an independent reviewer gates the goal when the advisor is silent. Escalates only when the goal is blocked on input only the user can provide (photo, device, physical action, unusable capture).

enabled.description: Arm the convergence loop. Off by default; arm per session with /adversarial on or durably with `omp plugin config --set enabled=true`.

minSeverity.description: Lowest finding severity (reviewer or advisor) that keeps the loop running.

maxRounds.description: Soft budget of continuation turns per user prompt. Crossing it raises pressure and notifies; it never hands the goal back.

maxRepeats.description: Times the reviewer may re-raise the same finding before the next round runs under stall pressure.

notify.description: Toast each round, convergence, stall pressure, budget crossing, and late advisor reopen.

includeAdvisor.description: Count unanswered advisor notes as findings alongside the reviewer. Requires the advisor subsystem; off means reviewer-only.

forceSyncBacklog.description: Pin advisor.syncBacklog to strict while armed, so a scheduled advisor review is not still in flight when the verdict is taken.

useSessionModel.description: Default the advisor's model to the session's live model. An explicitly configured modelRoles.advisor or WATCHDOG model still wins.
